title: Verifiable Intent failure: cumulative budget exceeded
summary: An Autonomous mandate carries a mandate.payment.budget cap. A new L3a would push cumulative spend over the cap, so the network rejects it. Only the network can enforce this, because it needs state across transactions.

steps.label: Present L3b
steps.detail: The checkout side passes: the merchant is allowed and the items match.

steps.label: Present L3a
steps.detail: The payment mandate amount is within amount_range, but the network adds it to the cumulative spend recorded for this L2 mandate pair, looked up by sd_hash.

steps.label: Reject: budget exceeded
steps.detail: The new cumulative total is above budget max, so the constraint is violated and the network does not authorize.

failures.condition: new cumulative spend greater than max

steps.label: Payment declined
steps.detail: If the L2 expires before the purchase is fulfilled, the spec says the implementation should prompt the user to authorize again.
